t: You're on Bouverie Street, a street in the City of London running off Fleet Street. It was once home to some of Britain's most widely circulated newspapers, and before that it was the site of Whitefriars Priory. The street takes its name from William Bouverie, the first Earl of Radnor. He was a British peer, known as the Honourable William Bouverie from 1747 until 1761. The material I have doesn't say more about his link to this spot, so I'll leave it there.
